name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
title: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd - 539334 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management has deliberately stopped sales since mid-March and deferred Unit 5/6 start-up (Rs 1,500cr FY27 target cut to Rs 1,250–1,300cr) as ammonia and sulphur prices roughly tripled; no Kharif revenue from new capacity.

capex.quote: we are still looking for a better opportunity and better right time to start it

triggers.label: FY27 sales cut to Rs 1,250-1,300cr
triggers.quote: we should be closing somewhere around Rs. 1,250 or maybe Rs. 1,300 crores of so

triggers.label: Unit 5/6 start-up deferred
triggers.quote: we do not expect any revenues from our Unit 6 as well as new expansion of Unit 5

triggers.label: Sales halted mid-March, stock held
triggers.quote: in the second week of March, we practically stopped our sales. We deliberately, intentionally stopped the sales.

triggers.label: Ammonia Rs 40-42 → Rs 100+/kg
triggers.quote: ammonia used to be Rs. 40- Rs. 42 a kg, now it is Rs. 100 plus

triggers.label: H Acid Rs 525-530 → Rs 750/kg
triggers.quote: Today, sir, we are easily able to sell this at Rs. 750 a kilo

guidance.quote: we should be closing somewhere around Rs. 1,250 or maybe Rs. 1,300 crores of so
PAT should be 8%,8.5%. This much I can tell you.
making a margin of around 8% to 10% will not be a great fight for us

prior_guidance_check.quote: we should be closing somewhere around Rs. 1,250 or maybe Rs. 1,300 crores of so

red_flags.label: Revenue not reconciled to volume
red_flags.quote: Overall consolidated volume for FY 26 reached 3,25,000 metric tons reflecting a growth of 2.5%

red_flags.label: Management could not answer volume/revenue questions
red_flags.quote: Deepak, I am not having the data in front of me. Can you address this question, please?

evasions.topic: Q4 chemical volume vs flat revenue
evasions.quote: We will answer this question to you through our IR.
it is difficult for me to quantify it today
We have not yet decided how and when we are going to start the trial production.
